chapter: The Shooting Range and the Deep Shadow Realm
act_title: The Shooting Range and the Deep Shadow Realm

quests.title: The Shooting Range and the Deep Shadow Realm

dialogue.t: This is a function of the Shadow Realm that has been set up as a shooting range... Once upon a time, (...) and (...) also used this function to train...
To further simulate the environment within the depths of the Shadow Realm and prepare for deeper delves into it...
Strange. These memories appear to have been erased.
But anyway, you can use this device to simulate a Shadow Realm, or the more oppressive Deep Shadow Realm...
You can even complete the training to unlock the corresponding access to blueprints for stronger firearms.
Ohh, so we train in here, and then we get the keys to unlock even stronger weapons!
That is the case. I applaud your swift understanding. In that case, please follow my instructions...
The firearms and accessories within the trophy case here are designed for those who have completed Shadow Realm training and Deep Shadow Realm cleansing operations.
Oh, so that's how it is!
In that case, that's all for the instructions. I recommend that you make preparations when you have time and try the facilities...
Access to the trophy case has been unlocked. New weapon accessories are now available for you to claim.

quests.description: After a battle in the Shadow Realm, the Eye of Graeae informs you that a new function has been unlocked for the shooting range accessible via the train.
